decisions.reason: This product is closely related to the firm's existing substrate and wafer-processing know-how, and with strong in-house R&D and research cooperation the firm is well placed to learn from early market use and improve a promising packaging-oriented offering.

The carrier wafer directly extends the firm's established carrier and thin-wafer handling business, so absorptive capacity is high and, absent negative market evidence, it is sensible to retain and refine it within the firm's focused portfolio.
